title: Rulebearing usage counts
description: One calendar month of one repository's usage counts: what `rulebearing --usage-counts print` shows. No path, no repository name and no user; a rule outside the public library appears only as a salted hash. Sending is not available in this release (ADR-0076).

version.description: The version of the binary that last counted into this month.

commands.description: Runs per top-level subcommand that read a configuration turning counting on.

rules.description: Per rule, the `cruise` runs in which it reported at least one violation. A rule of the public library is keyed by its name; any other by `sha256:` and the hex SHA-256 of the repository's salt followed by its name.
